items.title: Paquito D'Rivera — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I remember that the next LP was of a guy almost balding... And I find I enjoy that, and then that happen to me again with the Miles Davis new quintet, the quintet with Herbie Hancock and Tony Williams and Ron Carter.

ctx.x: How did you come to like it?

I don’t remember how that was, but I remember that it was almost immediately, a couple of pieces. I remember that the next LP was of a guy almost balding, a very fine alto and baritone player. That guy used to play baritone with Stan Kenton orchestra. And I remember that he had racing pianist and I don’t remember which of the men was playing drums, and that was a little more like post-bop type of thing.
